LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsDeliverMajorTree_Report: A kingdom war-detail arrived to inspect the major arms order.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsMajor_Deliver_Greeting: We are the war-detail from Rakinia, {Interviewer_labelShort}. We've come to inspect the top-grade arms—five longswords of Excellent quality, as agreed with the envoy.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsMajor_Deliver_OptDeliver: Deliver the arms (5 longswords, Excellent or better)
LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsMajor_Deliver_OptLater: Goods not ready; ask them to wait
LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsMajor_Deliver_Thanks: The war-detail examines every blade edge with care, then gives a solemn nod. They present 450 silver and a "Kingdom Conscription Writ." "The court has your name on the rolls," says the leader. "Well done."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsMajor_Deliver_MsgPaid: You delivered the major arms order: 450 silver and a Kingdom Conscription Writ received.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsMajor_NeedQuality: You don't yet have enough top-grade arms—need 5 longswords of "Excellent" quality or better.
